My projects show the technical and professional skills I am building through marketing analytics, GA4, BigQuery, Looker Studio, R programming, data wrangling, and reporting. Each project connects to a practical skill I can use in marketing, sports business, operations, or customer engagement work.

## Project Areas

- **GA4 and customer engagement:** Funnel analysis, traffic behavior, lead acquisition, and conversion recommendations.
- **Cloud analytics and dashboards:** BigQuery concepts, SQL-based analysis, and Looker Studio reporting.
- **R analytics:** Tidyverse wrangling, visualization, import/export, missing values, and functional programming.
- **Professional communication:** Clear summaries, project reflections, next-step recommendations, and client-oriented conclusions.

I am especially interested in using these skills in the sports industry, where fan behavior, media engagement, brand partnerships, and campaign performance all depend on understanding audiences clearly.
